integrity: Exact rational and integer fan checker is embedded and runnable; prior polyhedral and toric sources are separately identified; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact normal-fan result only for C7, reduced singular support and generic transverse models; no full singular-scheme computation or uniform theorem for all odd cycles. An unindexed equivalent classification remains possible.
title: Mixed-dimensional conifold and Segre strata of the seven-cycle stable-set toric variety
